newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Utilities cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Texas Utilities cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Friday it changed its rating on Texas Utilities Co to underperform from a near-term rating of market perform and a long-term rating of outperform.
-- Everen said it also cut its six-month stock price target to $30 a share from $41.
-- Texas Utilities shares were up 7/8 at 39-3/8.
-- This followed comments by a Texas commissioner that indicated a change of heart -- for the worse -- on recovery of stranded investment.
-- Texas Utilities "has significant stranded investment risk in its Comanche Peak nuclear plant," Everen said. "That risk is not discounted in the stock price."
-- No further details were immediately available.
-- Everen said its earnings estimates remain $3.35 a share in 1997 and $3.60 in 1998.
